title: Monotonicity of restricted runs
statement: Let a WordRAM program run from configuration $c$ to configuration $c'$ in $n$ steps, with every address touched at each step belonging to $K$. If $K\subseteq K'$, then every address touched at each step also belongs to $K'$, so the same run satisfies the restriction to $K'$.
hypotheses_covered: A run of $n$ steps from $c$ to $c'$ whose touched addresses all lie in $K$
